subject.title: [Bug]: codex agent fails ("exited with code 1") — macOS XProtect deletes bundled @openai/codex@0.128.0 as malware; codex-acp@0.0.44 pins the flagged version

question: Should system Codex recovery remain an explicit `CODEX_PATH` or custom agent-command override, or should acpx add a Codex-specific missing-binary fallback despite the prior decision against implicit global-binary preference?
rationale: Updating the affected adapter is a concrete bug fix, but automatic fallback changes executable provenance, version ownership, and a previously reviewed built-in launch contract.

options.title: Keep recovery explicit
options.body: Update and compatibility-test the pinned adapter, then document `CODEX_PATH` and custom agent-command recovery without silent PATH lookup.

options.title: Fallback only when missing
options.body: Use a PATH-resolved Codex only after narrowly detecting a missing bundled executable and visibly report the selected path and version.

options.title: Revisit global preference
options.body: Reconsider the broader installed-binary-first direction from https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/pull/230 for package-backed built-ins.

recommendation.title: Keep recovery explicit
recommendation.body: Update and compatibility-test the pinned adapter, then document `CODEX_PATH` and custom agent-command recovery without silent PATH lookup.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the clearest prior product-direction review on executable precedence and has recent history on built-in adapter ranges.
